main_subject.description: An original adult East Asian woman with long dark straight hair, natural satin skin, and a calm confident gaze.

main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing beside a glowing white geometric block, one hand lightly touching hair and the other resting on the block.

composition_elements.setting: Minimal industrial urban gym interior with cool blue-gray walls and dark tiled floor.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin texture, precise fabric detail, crisp edges, gentle cool tonal contrast, and realistic hands.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 vertical minimal high-fashion editorial photograph of an original adult East Asian woman with long dark straight hair, natural satin skin, and a calm confident gaze. She wears a sand-beige relaxed crew-neck athletic T-shirt, high-waisted black wide-leg track trousers with plain pale side piping, white crew socks, and plain mint-and-silver trainers. Stand her beside a glowing white geometric block, one hand lightly touching hair and the other resting on the block. Set her in a minimalist industrial urban gym with cool blue-gray walls and dark tiled floor. Use bright clean studio lighting, a soft futuristic block glow, centered full-body framing, natural skin, detailed fabric, crisp edges, gentle cool contrast, and realistic hands. No celebrity likeness, athletic-brand name, three-stripe motif, trefoil-style icon, shoe logo, readable text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, named singer, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, crop top, athletic shorts, lingerie, logo, three stripes, trefoil, readable text, watermark, plastic skin, distorted hands, AI artifacts
